 BGMI 4.7 Update Features Arctic Chronicles, Erangel Subzero Mode, and Snow Festival
 New vehicles, cold-weather gear, and more.
 By   Aritra Bhowmick   
 Updated: Nov. 10, 2026, 3:27 p.m. 
 Related reads: BGMI Air Opens Pre-Registrations for iOS Ahead of December Launch 
 Krafton India has shared details about Battlegrounds Mobile India (BGMI) upcoming 4.7 update, highlighting Arctic Chronicles themed mode and other things. More like this Revenant XSpark Bring Back Two-Time Champion BGMI Player To Their Team 
Arriving on November 18, 2026, the update will introduce Arctic Chronicles, which will remain available until January 18, 2027. Players will be able to experience the mode across Erangel, Livik, and Vikendi. That won't be the only winter-themed addition, as Krafton is also preparing Erangel Subzero themed mode for December 3, 2026. The mode will be available in Ranked matches on Erangel, bringing new cold-weather gear and vehicles.
 View this post on Instagram 
 A post shared by BGMI: BATTLEGROUNDS MOBILE INDIA (@battlegroundsmobilein_official) 
 Beyond the themed modes, the 4.7 update will also feature the Snow Festival, starting December 17. It will bring a festive playground to the game. BGMI will also feature a New Year countdown on December 31, with a giant timer appearing across most maps from 8 PM IST, followed by a fireworks display at midnight.
 Krafton has also teased the Ancient Beast, which players can awaken by blowing a horn, causing a submerged tower to rise from the water. The creature's body will become part of the terrain, revealing new areas to explore, supplies, and more.
 Meanwhile, Krafton India has also announced BGMI Air, a lighter version of BGMI. The game is scheduled for release on December 10, 2026 .
